<body>
<div id="top">
  <button class="tool active" id="toolCrater"><span class="menuCrater"></span> Bombardavimo duobė</button>
  <button class="tool" id="toolBuilding"><span class="menuBuilding"></span> Sugriautas pastatas</button>
  <button class="tool" id="toolErase">⌫ Trinti</button>

  <button id="export">Eksportuoti taškus</button>
  <button id="importBtn">Importuoti taškus</button>

  <span id="count"></span>
</div>
<div id="view">
  <div id="stage"><img id="photo" alt="Virbalio aeronuotrauka" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"></div>

  <div id="imageControls">
    <div class="controlGroup">
      <label for="brightness">☀ Ryškumas</label>
      <input id="brightness" type="range" min="50" max="180" value="100" step="1">
      <span id="brightnessValue" class="controlValue">100%</span>
    </div>
    <div class="controlGroup">
      <label for="contrast">◐ Kontrastas</label>
      <input id="contrast" type="range" min="50" max="220" value="100" step="1">
      <span id="contrastValue" class="controlValue">100%</span>
    </div>
    <button id="resetImage" title="Atstatyti ryškumą ir kontrastą">↺</button>
  </div>

</div>
<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
var IW=3413, IH=3329;
var view=document.getElementById("view"), stage=document.getElementById("stage");
var canvas=document.getElementById("overlay"), ctx=canvas.getContext("2d"), count=document.getElementById("count");

var scale=1, tx=0, ty=0, tool="crater", marks=[], selected=-1;
var dragging=false, dragKind="", downX=0, downY=0, startTx=0, startTy=0, draft=null;
var rotateStartAngle=0, rotateBaseAngle=0;
var resizeCorner=null, resizeFixed=null, resizeCenter=null, resizeAngle=0;
var moveIndex=-1, moveOffsetX=0, moveOffsetY=0;
var KEY="virbalis_bombardavimo_zymejimai_v2";
var CLOUD_URL_KEY="virbalis_supabase_url";
var CLOUD_ANON_KEY="virbalis_supabase_anon";
var CLOUD_ROW_ID="virbalis_1941_bombardavimas";
var IMAGE_BRIGHTNESS_KEY="virbalis_image_brightness";
var IMAGE_CONTRAST_KEY="virbalis_image_contrast";
var cloudTimer=null, cloudBusy=false, touchMode="", touchStart=null, pinchStart=null;
var lastCloudTimestamp="";
var localDirty=false;
var periodicSyncTimer=null;

function setTool(name){
  tool=name;
  document.getElementById("toolCrater").classList.toggle("active",name==="crater");
  document.getElementById("toolBuilding").classList.toggle("active",name==="building");
  document.getElementById("toolErase").classList.toggle("active",name==="erase");
}

function load(){
  try{var s=localStorage.getItem(KEY); if(s) marks=JSON.parse(s)||[];}catch(e){marks=[];}
  for(var i=0;i<marks.length;i++) if(marks[i].type==="building"){
    if(typeof marks[i].w!=="number") marks[i].w=12;
    if(typeof marks[i].h!=="number") marks[i].h=12;
    if(typeof marks[i].angle!=="number") marks[i].angle=0;
  }
}
function save(){
  try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(marks));}catch(e){}
  scheduleCloudSave();
}
function cloudConfig(){
  return {
    url:(localStorage.getItem(CLOUD_URL_KEY)||"https://sxteagtesmujkhtzwwod.supabase.co").replace(/\/+$/,""),
    key:localStorage.getItem(CLOUD_ANON_KEY)||"sb_publishable_CYqJvx7P4udqYFMYPdf0ug_Unsun2D1"
  };
}
function setCloudStatus(text,kind){}
function scheduleCloudSave(){
  localDirty=true;
  var c=cloudConfig();
  if(!c.url||!c.key){setCloudStatus("☁ vietinis","");return;}
  clearTimeout(cloudTimer);
  cloudTimer=setTimeout(pushCloud,450);
}
async function pushCloud(){
  var c=cloudConfig();
  if(!c.url||!c.key||cloudBusy)return;
  cloudBusy=true;setCloudStatus("☁ saugoma…","");
  try{
    var res=await fetch(c.url+"/rest/v1/map_states?on_conflict=id",{
      method:"POST",
      headers:{
        "apikey":c.key,
        "Content-Type":"application/json","Prefer":"resolution=merge-duplicates,return=minimal"
      },
      body:JSON.stringify([{id:CLOUD_ROW_ID,marks:marks,updated_at:new Date().toISOString()}])
    });
    if(!res.ok)throw new Error("HTTP "+res.status+" "+await res.text());
    localDirty=false;
    lastCloudTimestamp=new Date().toISOString();
    setCloudStatus("☁ išsaugota","ok");
  }catch(e){
    setCloudStatus("☁ klaida","err");
      }finally{cloudBusy=false;}
}
async function pullCloud(){
  var c=cloudConfig();
  if(!c.url||!c.key)throw new Error("Neįvesti Supabase duomenys.");
  setCloudStatus("☁ kraunama…","");
  var res=await fetch(c.url+"/rest/v1/map_states?id=eq."+encodeURIComponent(CLOUD_ROW_ID)+"&select=marks,updated_at",{
    headers:{"apikey":c.key}
  });
  if(!res.ok)throw new Error("HTTP "+res.status+" "+await res.text());
  var rows=await res.json();
  if(rows.length&&Array.isArray(rows[0].marks)){
    var remoteTs=rows[0].updated_at||"";
    if(!localDirty && (!lastCloudTimestamp || remoteTs!==lastCloudTimestamp)){
      marks=rows[0].marks;
      try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(marks));}catch(e){}
      selected=-1;draw();
      lastCloudTimestamp=remoteTs;
    }
    setCloudStatus("☁ sinchronizuota","ok");
    return true;
  }
  // Jei serveris tuščias, įkeliame šiame įrenginyje jau turimus žymėjimus.
  await pushCloud();
  return false;
}

function resizeCanvas(){
  var dpr=Math.max(1,window.devicePixelRatio||1), w=Math.max(1,view.clientWidth), h=Math.max(1,view.clientHeight);
  canvas.width=Math.round(w*dpr); canvas.height=Math.round(h*dpr);
  canvas.style.width=w+"px"; canvas.style.height=h+"px";
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0); draw();
}
function updateTransform(){stage.style.transform="translate("+tx+"px,"+ty+"px) scale("+scale+")";draw();}
function fit(){var vw=view.clientWidth,vh=view.clientHeight;scale=Math.min(vw/IW,vh/IH);tx=(vw-IW*scale)/2;ty=(vh-IH*scale)/2;updateTransform();}
function screenToImage(clientX,clientY){var r=view.getBoundingClientRect();return {x:(clientX-r.left-tx)/scale,y:(clientY-r.top-ty)/scale};}
function imageToScreen(x,y){return {x:tx+x*scale,y:ty+y*scale};}

function buildingCenter(m){return {x:m.x+m.w/2,y:m.y+m.h/2};}
function localToImage(cx,cy,lx,ly,a){var ca=Math.cos(a),sa=Math.sin(a);return {x:cx+lx*ca-ly*sa,y:cy+lx*sa+ly*ca};}
function imageToLocal(px,py,cx,cy,a){var ca=Math.cos(-a),sa=Math.sin(-a),dx=px-cx,dy=py-cy;return {x:dx*ca-dy*sa,y:dx*sa+dy*ca};}

function drawCrater(m){
  var p=imageToScreen(m.x,m.y);
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(Math.round(p.x)+0.5,Math.round(p.y)+0.5,5,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.lineWidth=1.35;ctx.strokeStyle="#ff1712";ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(Math.round(p.x)+0.5,Math.round(p.y)+0.5,1.6,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fillStyle="#ff1712";ctx.fill();
}

function buildingCornersScreen(m){
  var c=buildingCenter(m), a=m.angle||0, hw=m.w/2, hh=m.h/2;
  var locals=[[-hw,-hh],[hw,-hh],[hw,hh],[-hw,hh]];
  return locals.map(function(v){var p=localToImage(c.x,c.y,v[0],v[1],a);return imageToScreen(p.x,p.y);});
}
function rotationHandleScreen(m){
  var c=buildingCenter(m), a=m.angle||0, sc=imageToScreen(c.x,c.y), off=(m.h*scale)/2+24;
  return {x:sc.x+Math.sin(a)*off,y:sc.y-Math.cos(a)*off};
}

function drawBuilding(m,isSelected,alpha){
  var c=buildingCenter(m), sc=imageToScreen(c.x,c.y), w=m.w*scale,h=m.h*scale,a=m.angle||0;
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=alpha==null?1:alpha;ctx.translate(sc.x,sc.y);ctx.rotate(a);
  ctx.lineWidth=1.35;ctx.strokeStyle="#008cff";ctx.strokeRect(-w/2,-h/2,w,h);
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-w/2,-h/2);ctx.lineTo(w/2,h/2);ctx.moveTo(w/2,-h/2);ctx.lineTo(-w/2,h/2);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();

  if(isSelected){
    var cs=buildingCornersScreen(m);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.setLineDash([4,3]);ctx.strokeStyle="#fff";ctx.lineWidth=1;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cs[0].x,cs[0].y);for(var i=1;i<4;i++)ctx.lineTo(cs[i].x,cs[i].y);ctx.closePath();ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);
    for(var j=0;j<4;j++){
      ctx.fillStyle="#fff";ctx.strokeStyle="#008cff";ctx.lineWidth=1.3;
      ctx.fillRect(cs[j].x-4,cs[j].y-4,8,8);ctx.strokeRect(cs[j].x-4,cs[j].y-4,8,8);
    }
    var rh=rotationHandleScreen(m);
    var topMid={x:(cs[0].x+cs[1].x)/2,y:(cs[0].y+cs[1].y)/2};
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(topMid.x,topMid.y);ctx.lineTo(rh.x,rh.y);ctx.strokeStyle="#fff";ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(rh.x,rh.y,5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle="#fff";ctx.fill();ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.strokeStyle="#008cff";ctx.stroke();
    // Centro rankenėlė pastato perkėlimui
    var cc=imageToScreen(c.x,c.y);
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cc.x,cc.y,4.5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle="#ffffff";ctx.fill();ctx.lineWidth=1.4;ctx.strokeStyle="#008cff";ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function draw(){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,view.clientWidth,view.clientHeight);
  for(var i=0;i<marks.length;i++) marks[i].type==="crater"?drawCrater(marks[i]):drawBuilding(marks[i],i===selected,1);
  if(draft&&draft.type==="building") drawBuilding(draft,false,.9);
  var c=0,b=0;for(var j=0;j<marks.length;j++) marks[j].type==="crater"?c++:b++;
  count.textContent="Duobės: "+c+" | Sugriauti pastatai: "+b+" | Iš viso: "+marks.length;
}

function addCrater(p){if(p.x<0||p.y<0||p.x>IW||p.y>IH)return;marks.push({type:"crater",x:+p.x.toFixed(1),y:+p.y.toFixed(1)});selected=-1;save();draw();}
function rectFromPoints(a,b){return {type:"building",x:Math.min(a.x,b.x),y:Math.min(a.y,b.y),w:Math.abs(b.x-a.x),h:Math.abs(b.y-a.y),angle:0};}

function pointInBuilding(p,m,padPx){
  var c=buildingCenter(m),q=imageToLocal(p.x,p.y,c.x,c.y,m.angle||0),pad=(padPx||0)/scale;
  return Math.abs(q.x)<=m.w/2+pad && Math.abs(q.y)<=m.h/2+pad;
}
function findBuildingAt(p){for(var i=marks.length-1;i>=0;i--)if(marks[i].type==="building"&&pointInBuilding(p,marks[i],6))return i;return -1;}

function hitRotationHandle(clientX,clientY){
  if(selected<0||!marks[selected]||marks[selected].type!=="building")return false;
  var h=rotationHandleScreen(marks[selected]),r=view.getBoundingClientRect(),x=clientX-r.left,y=clientY-r.top,dx=x-h.x,dy=y-h.y;
  return dx*dx+dy*dy<=12*12;
}
function hitResizeHandle(clientX,clientY){
  if(selected<0||!marks[selected]||marks[selected].type!=="building")return -1;
  var cs=buildingCornersScreen(marks[selected]),r=view.getBoundingClientRect(),x=clientX-r.left,y=clientY-r.top;
  var best=-1,bd=9999;
  for(var i=0;i<4;i++){var dx=x-cs[i].x,dy=y-cs[i].y,d=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(d<bd){bd=d;best=i;}}
  return bd<=12*12?best:-1;
}

function hitCraterAt(p){
  for(var i=marks.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    var m=marks[i];
    if(m.type==="crater"){
      var dx=m.x-p.x,dy=m.y-p.y;
      if(dx*dx+dy*dy <= Math.pow(5/scale,2)) return i;
    }
  }
  return -1;
}
function hitBuildingCenter(clientX,clientY){
  if(selected<0||!marks[selected]||marks[selected].type!=="building") return false;
  var c=buildingCenter(marks[selected]),s=imageToScreen(c.x,c.y),r=view.getBoundingClientRect();
  var dx=(clientX-r.left)-s.x,dy=(clientY-r.top)-s.y;
  return dx*dx+dy*dy<=11*11;
}

function eraseAt(p){
  if(!marks.length)return;
  var best=-1,bestD=Infinity;
  for(var i=0;i<marks.length;i++){
    var m=marks[i],d;
    if(m.type==="building"){
      if(pointInBuilding(p,m,10)) d=0;
      else{var c=buildingCenter(m),dx=c.x-p.x,dy=c.y-p.y;d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);}
    }else{var dx2=m.x-p.x,dy2=m.y-p.y;d=Math.sqrt(dx2*dx2+dy2*dy2);}
    if(d<bestD){bestD=d;best=i;}
  }
  if(best>=0&&bestD<=16/scale){marks.splice(best,1);if(selected===best)selected=-1;else if(selected>best)selected--;save();draw();}
}

view.addEventListener("contextmenu",function(e){e.preventDefault();});
view.addEventListener("mousedown",function(e){
  e.preventDefault();downX=e.clientX;downY=e.clientY;

  if(e.button===0){dragging=true;dragKind="pan";startTx=tx;startTy=ty;view.style.cursor="grabbing";return;}
  if(e.button===1){eraseAt(screenToImage(e.clientX,e.clientY));return;}
  if(e.button!==2)return;

  var p=screenToImage(e.clientX,e.clientY);
  if(tool==="erase"){eraseAt(p);return;}
  if(tool==="crater"){
    var ci=hitCraterAt(p);
    if(ci>=0){
      moveIndex=ci;
      moveOffsetX=marks[ci].x-p.x; moveOffsetY=marks[ci].y-p.y;
      dragging=true;dragKind="move";return;
    }
    addCrater(p);return;
  }

  if(tool==="building"){
    if(hitBuildingCenter(e.clientX,e.clientY)){
      var bm=marks[selected],bc=buildingCenter(bm);
      moveIndex=selected; moveOffsetX=bc.x-p.x; moveOffsetY=bc.y-p.y;
      dragging=true;dragKind="moveBuilding";return;
    }
    if(hitRotationHandle(e.clientX,e.clientY)){
      var rm=marks[selected],rc=buildingCenter(rm),rsp=imageToScreen(rc.x,rc.y),rr=view.getBoundingClientRect();
      rotateStartAngle=Math.atan2((e.clientY-rr.top)-rsp.y,(e.clientX-rr.left)-rsp.x);
      rotateBaseAngle=rm.angle||0;dragging=true;dragKind="rotate";return;
    }

    var hc=hitResizeHandle(e.clientX,e.clientY);
    if(hc>=0){
      var m=marks[selected], c=buildingCenter(m), a=m.angle||0, hw=m.w/2, hh=m.h/2;
      var signs=[[-1,-1],[1,-1],[1,1],[-1,1]];
      var opp=(hc+2)%4;
      resizeCorner=hc; resizeAngle=a;
      resizeFixed=localToImage(c.x,c.y,signs[opp][0]*hw,signs[opp][1]*hh,a);
      dragging=true;dragKind="resize";return;
    }

    var hit=findBuildingAt(p);
    if(hit>=0){selected=hit;draw();return;}

    dragging=true;dragKind="building";draft={type:"building",x:p.x,y:p.y,w:0,h:0,angle:0,_startX:p.x,_startY:p.y};selected=-1;draw();
  }
});

window.addEventListener("mousemove",function(e){
  if(!dragging)return;
  if(dragKind==="pan"){tx=startTx+(e.clientX-downX);ty=startTy+(e.clientY-downY);updateTransform();return;}

  if(dragKind==="building"&&draft){
    var p=screenToImage(e.clientX,e.clientY),a={x:draft._startX,y:draft._startY},nr=rectFromPoints(a,p);
    nr._startX=a.x;nr._startY=a.y;draft=nr;draw();return;
  }

  if(dragKind==="rotate"&&selected>=0){
    var m=marks[selected],c=buildingCenter(m),sp=imageToScreen(c.x,c.y),r=view.getBoundingClientRect();
    var ang=Math.atan2((e.clientY-r.top)-sp.y,(e.clientX-r.left)-sp.x);
    m.angle=rotateBaseAngle+(ang-rotateStartAngle);draw();return;
  }

  if(dragKind==="move"&&moveIndex>=0){
    var mp=screenToImage(e.clientX,e.clientY),mm=marks[moveIndex];
    mm.x=mp.x+moveOffsetX;mm.y=mp.y+moveOffsetY;draw();return;
  }

  if(dragKind==="moveBuilding"&&moveIndex>=0){
    var bp=screenToImage(e.clientX,e.clientY),bm=marks[moveIndex];
    var ncx=bp.x+moveOffsetX,ncy=bp.y+moveOffsetY;
    bm.x=ncx-bm.w/2;bm.y=ncy-bm.h/2;draw();return;
  }

  if(dragKind==="resize"&&selected>=0){
    var p=screenToImage(e.clientX,e.clientY);
    // Dirbame pasukto stačiakampio vietinėje koordinačių sistemoje, todėl dydis keičiasi išlaikant kampą.
    var fixed=resizeFixed, a=resizeAngle;
    var ca=Math.cos(-a),sa=Math.sin(-a);
    var dx=p.x-fixed.x,dy=p.y-fixed.y;
    var lx=dx*ca-dy*sa,ly=dx*sa+dy*ca;

    var signs=[[-1,-1],[1,-1],[1,1],[-1,1]];
    var sx=signs[resizeCorner][0], sy=signs[resizeCorner][1];
    var w=Math.max(3,Math.abs(lx)), h=Math.max(3,Math.abs(ly));

    // Naujas centras yra tarp fiksuoto priešingo kampo ir tempiamo kampo.
    var localDrag={x:sx*w,y:sy*h};
    var dragImg=localToImage(fixed.x,fixed.y,localDrag.x,localDrag.y,a);
    var cx=(fixed.x+dragImg.x)/2, cy=(fixed.y+dragImg.y)/2;

    var m=marks[selected];
    m.w=w;m.h=h;m.x=cx-w/2;m.y=cy-h/2;m.angle=a;
    draw();return;
  }
});

window.addEventListener("mouseup",function(){
  if(!dragging)return;
  if(dragKind==="building"&&draft){
    if(draft.w>=3&&draft.h>=3){delete draft._startX;delete draft._startY;marks.push(draft);selected=marks.length-1;save();}
    draft=null;
  } else if(dragKind==="rotate"||dragKind==="resize"||dragKind==="move"||dragKind==="moveBuilding") save();
  dragging=false;dragKind="";view.style.cursor="grab";draw();
});


function touchPoint(tch){return screenToImage(tch.clientX,tch.clientY);}
function touchDistance(a,b){var dx=a.clientX-b.clientX,dy=a.clientY-b.clientY;return Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);}
function touchMid(a,b){return {x:(a.clientX+b.clientX)/2,y:(a.clientY+b.clientY)/2};}

view.addEventListener("touchstart",function(e){
  if(e.touches.length===2){
    e.preventDefault();
    touchMode="pinch";
    var mid=touchMid(e.touches[0],e.touches[1]),r=view.getBoundingClientRect();
    pinchStart={
      dist:touchDistance(e.touches[0],e.touches[1]),scale:scale,tx:tx,ty:ty,
      mx:mid.x-r.left,my:mid.y-r.top,
      ix:(mid.x-r.left-tx)/scale,iy:(mid.y-r.top-ty)/scale
    };
    return;
  }
  if(e.touches.length!==1)return;
  e.preventDefault();
  var tch=e.touches[0],p=touchPoint(tch);
  touchStart={clientX:tch.clientX,clientY:tch.clientY,p:p};

  // Vienu pirštu pradžioje laukiame: trumpas bakstelėjimas = žymėjimas,
  // tempimas tuščioje vietoje = vaizdo stumdymas.
  if(tool==="erase"){eraseAt(p);touchMode="";return;}
  if(tool==="crater"){
    var ci=hitCraterAt(p);
    if(ci>=0){moveIndex=ci;moveOffsetX=marks[ci].x-p.x;moveOffsetY=marks[ci].y-p.y;touchMode="move";return;}
    touchMode="pendingTap";startTx=tx;startTy=ty;downX=tch.clientX;downY=tch.clientY;return;
  }
  if(tool==="building"){
    if(hitBuildingCenter(tch.clientX,tch.clientY)){
      var bm=marks[selected],bc=buildingCenter(bm);
      moveIndex=selected;moveOffsetX=bc.x-p.x;moveOffsetY=bc.y-p.y;touchMode="moveBuilding";return;
    }
    if(hitRotationHandle(tch.clientX,tch.clientY)){
      var rm=marks[selected],rc=buildingCenter(rm),rsp=imageToScreen(rc.x,rc.y),rr=view.getBoundingClientRect();
      rotateStartAngle=Math.atan2((tch.clientY-rr.top)-rsp.y,(tch.clientX-rr.left)-rsp.x);
      rotateBaseAngle=rm.angle||0;touchMode="rotate";return;
    }
    var hc=hitResizeHandle(tch.clientX,tch.clientY);
    if(hc>=0){
      var m=marks[selected],c=buildingCenter(m),a=m.angle||0,hw=m.w/2,hh=m.h/2;
      var signs=[[-1,-1],[1,-1],[1,1],[-1,1]],opp=(hc+2)%4;
      resizeCorner=hc;resizeAngle=a;
      resizeFixed=localToImage(c.x,c.y,signs[opp][0]*hw,signs[opp][1]*hh,a);
      touchMode="resize";return;
    }
    var hit=findBuildingAt(p);
    if(hit>=0){selected=hit;draw();touchMode="";return;}
    selected=-1;
    touchMode="pendingBuilding";
    startTx=tx;startTy=ty;downX=tch.clientX;downY=tch.clientY;
    draw();
  }
},{passive:false});

view.addEventListener("touchmove",function(e){
  if(e.touches.length===2&&touchMode==="pinch"&&pinchStart){
    e.preventDefault();
    var ns=Math.max(.08,Math.min(16,pinchStart.scale*touchDistance(e.touches[0],e.touches[1])/pinchStart.dist));
    var mid=touchMid(e.touches[0],e.touches[1]),r=view.getBoundingClientRect();
    var mx=mid.x-r.left,my=mid.y-r.top;
    tx=mx-pinchStart.ix*ns;ty=my-pinchStart.iy*ns;scale=ns;updateTransform();return;
  }
  if(e.touches.length!==1)return;
  e.preventDefault();
  var tch=e.touches[0],p=touchPoint(tch);

  if(touchMode==="pan"){tx=startTx+(tch.clientX-downX);ty=startTy+(tch.clientY-downY);updateTransform();return;}
  if(touchMode==="pendingTap"){
    var ddx=tch.clientX-downX,ddy=tch.clientY-downY;
    if(ddx*ddx+ddy*ddy>64){
      touchMode="pan";
      tx=startTx+ddx;ty=startTy+ddy;updateTransform();
    }
    return;
  }
  if(touchMode==="pendingBuilding"){
    var bdx=tch.clientX-downX,bdy=tch.clientY-downY;
    if(bdx*bdx+bdy*bdy>64){
      var sp=touchStart.p;
      draft={type:"building",x:sp.x,y:sp.y,w:0,h:0,angle:0,_startX:sp.x,_startY:sp.y};
      touchMode="building";
      var nr=rectFromPoints(sp,p);nr._startX=sp.x;nr._startY=sp.y;draft=nr;draw();
    }
    return;
  }
  if(touchMode==="move"&&moveIndex>=0){marks[moveIndex].x=p.x+moveOffsetX;marks[moveIndex].y=p.y+moveOffsetY;draw();return;}
  if(touchMode==="moveBuilding"&&moveIndex>=0){
    var bm=marks[moveIndex],cx=p.x+moveOffsetX,cy=p.y+moveOffsetY;
    bm.x=cx-bm.w/2;bm.y=cy-bm.h/2;draw();return;
  }
  if(touchMode==="building"&&draft){
    var a={x:draft._startX,y:draft._startY},nr=rectFromPoints(a,p);
    nr._startX=a.x;nr._startY=a.y;draft=nr;draw();return;
  }
  if(touchMode==="rotate"&&selected>=0){
    var m=marks[selected],c=buildingCenter(m),sp=imageToScreen(c.x,c.y),r=view.getBoundingClientRect();
    var ang=Math.atan2((tch.clientY-r.top)-sp.y,(tch.clientX-r.left)-sp.x);
    m.angle=rotateBaseAngle+(ang-rotateStartAngle);draw();return;
  }
  if(touchMode==="resize"&&selected>=0){
    var fixed=resizeFixed,a=resizeAngle,ca=Math.cos(-a),sa=Math.sin(-a);
    var dx=p.x-fixed.x,dy=p.y-fixed.y,lx=dx*ca-dy*sa,ly=dx*sa+dy*ca;
    var signs=[[-1,-1],[1,-1],[1,1],[-1,1]],sx=signs[resizeCorner][0],sy=signs[resizeCorner][1];
    var w=Math.max(3,Math.abs(lx)),h=Math.max(3,Math.abs(ly));
    var dragImg=localToImage(fixed.x,fixed.y,sx*w,sy*h,a);
    var cx=(fixed.x+dragImg.x)/2,cy=(fixed.y+dragImg.y)/2,m=marks[selected];
    m.w=w;m.h=h;m.x=cx-w/2;m.y=cy-h/2;m.angle=a;draw();return;
  }
},{passive:false});

view.addEventListener("touchend",function(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  if(touchMode==="pendingTap"&&touchStart){
    addCrater(touchStart.p);
  }else if(touchMode==="building"&&draft){
    if(draft.w>=3&&draft.h>=3){delete draft._startX;delete draft._startY;marks.push(draft);selected=marks.length-1;save();}
    draft=null;
  }else if(["move","moveBuilding","rotate","resize"].indexOf(touchMode)>=0){
    save();
  }
  touchMode="";pinchStart=null;touchStart=null;draw();
},{passive:false});

view.addEventListener("wheel",function(e){
  e.preventDefault();var r=view.getBoundingClientRect(),mx=e.clientX-r.left,my=e.clientY-r.top,ix=(mx-tx)/scale,iy=(my-ty)/scale;
  var ns=Math.max(.08,Math.min(16,scale*(e.deltaY<0?1.18:1/1.18)));tx=mx-ix*ns;ty=my-iy*ns;scale=ns;updateTransform();
},{passive:false});

document.getElementById("toolCrater").onclick=function(){setTool("crater");};
document.getElementById("toolBuilding").onclick=function(){setTool("building");};
document.getElementById("toolErase").onclick=function(){setTool("erase");};

var syncModal=document.getElementById("syncModal");
function openSync(){
  document.getElementById("sbUrl").value=localStorage.getItem(CLOUD_URL_KEY)||"https://sxteagtesmujkhtzwwod.supabase.co";
  document.getElementById("sbKey").value=localStorage.getItem(CLOUD_ANON_KEY)||"sb_publishable_CYqJvx7P4udqYFMYPdf0ug_Unsun2D1";
    syncModal.classList.add("show");
}


document.getElementById("importBtn").onclick=function(){
  document.getElementById("importFile").click();
};
document.getElementById("importFile").addEventListener("change",function(e){
  var file=e.target.files&&e.target.files[0];
  if(!file)return;
  var reader=new FileReader();
  reader.onload=function(){
    try{
      var data=JSON.parse(reader.result);
      var incoming=Array.isArray(data)?data:data.marks;
      if(!Array.isArray(incoming))throw new Error("Faile nėra žymėjimų masyvo.");
      if(!confirm("Importuoti "+incoming.length+" žymėjimų? Dabartiniai žymėjimai bus pakeisti."))return;
      marks=incoming;
      for(var i=0;i<marks.length;i++){
        if(marks[i].type==="building"){
          if(typeof marks[i].w!=="number")marks[i].w=12;
          if(typeof marks[i].h!=="number")marks[i].h=12;
          if(typeof marks[i].angle!=="number")marks[i].angle=0;
        }
      }
      selected=-1;
      save();
      draw();
      setCloudStatus("☁ išsaugoma…","");
    }catch(err){
      alert("Nepavyko importuoti failo: "+err.message);
    }finally{
      e.target.value="";
    }
  };
  reader.readAsText(file);
});

document.getElementById("export").onclick=function(){
  var data={version:15,image:{width:IW,height:IH,name:"RG_373_GX_4147_SG_297_102(4)"},marks:marks};
  var blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(data,null,2)],{type:"application/json"}),a=document.createElement("a");
  a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download="Virbalis_taškai_v15.json";document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();document.body.removeChild(a);
  setTimeout(function(){URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);},500);
};
window.addEventListener("resize",function(){resizeCanvas();fit();});

var brightness=document.getElementById("brightness");
var contrast=document.getElementById("contrast");
var brightnessValue=document.getElementById("brightnessValue");
var contrastValue=document.getElementById("contrastValue");
var photo=document.getElementById("photo");

function applyImageAdjustments(){
  var b=parseInt(brightness.value,10)||100;
  var c=parseInt(contrast.value,10)||100;
  photo.style.filter="brightness("+b+"%) contrast("+c+"%)";
  brightnessValue.textContent=b+"%";
  contrastValue.textContent=c+"%";
  try{
    localStorage.setItem(IMAGE_BRIGHTNESS_KEY,String(b));
    localStorage.setItem(IMAGE_CONTRAST_KEY,String(c));
  }catch(e){}
}
(function loadImageAdjustments(){
  try{
    var b=localStorage.getItem(IMAGE_BRIGHTNESS_KEY);
    var c=localStorage.getItem(IMAGE_CONTRAST_KEY);
    if(b!==null) brightness.value=b;
    if(c!==null) contrast.value=c;
  }catch(e){}
  applyImageAdjustments();
})();
brightness.addEventListener("input",applyImageAdjustments);
contrast.addEventListener("input",applyImageAdjustments);
document.getElementById("resetImage").onclick=function(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  brightness.value=100;
  contrast.value=100;
  applyImageAdjustments();
};

// Valdikliai neturi sukelti žemėlapio stūmimo ar žymėjimo.
document.getElementById("imageControls").addEventListener("mousedown",function(e){e.stopPropagation();});
document.getElementById("imageControls").addEventListener("touchstart",function(e){e.stopPropagation();},{passive:true});

load();resizeCanvas();fit();setTool("crater");

async function startupSync(){
  var cc=cloudConfig();
  if(!cc.url||!cc.key){setCloudStatus("☁ nesukonfigūruota","err");return;}
  if(!navigator.onLine){setCloudStatus("☁ nėra interneto","err");return;}
  try{
    await pullCloud();
  }catch(e){
    setCloudStatus("☁ ryšio klaida","err");
      }
}

function startPeriodicSync(){
  clearInterval(periodicSyncTimer);
  periodicSyncTimer=setInterval(function(){
    if(!navigator.onLine || localDirty) return;
    pullCloud().catch(function(){});
  },10000);
}

window.addEventListener("online",function(){
  setCloudStatus("☁ jungiamasi…","");
  startupSync();
});
window.addEventListener("offline",function(){
  setCloudStatus("☁ nėra interneto","err");
});
document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",function(){
  if(!document.hidden && navigator.onLine && !localDirty) pullCloud().catch(function(){});
});

startupSync();
startPeriodicSync();
})();
</script>
